title: Document shard library config trust boundary
description: loadLibraries() does not validate that lib.indexPath / lib.shardDir are contained within the repo root. They originate from .orchestrator.json (repo-owned) so this is a known trust boundary. Document this explicitly in PLAN.md §3a (security note) and in the JSDoc for loadLibraries.
acceptance_criteria: PLAN.md §3a includes a 'Trust boundary' subsection or note
loadLibraries JSDoc mentions the trust boundary
